title: Self-Reinforcing Error Defense — the strengthen() vulnerability and the DETECT→QUARANTINE→TRACE→REVALIDATE→RECOVER pipeline

source.source_reference: Shawn's explicit teaching, main chat, 2026-10-10. Filed same-evening per his standing law: his word IS the verification (Verification Law); filed immediately, not queued.

intelligence.essence: A reproduced vulnerability: a lesson's strengthen() path could reinforce its own error instead of correcting it — the system gets more confident in a mistake each time it touches it. The defense is a seven-predicate qualify_lesson gate that every lesson must pass before promotion, plus a five-stage pipeline: DETECT (find the reinforcement pattern), QUARANTINE (isolate the suspect lesson from active retrieval), TRACE (find where the false claim spread), REVALIDATE (re-check the claim against independent evidence), RECOVER (correct or demote, preserving provenance of the error). Errors are fossilized, not erased: the wrong version stays visible with its correction attached so successors don't re-learn the mistake.

human_view.meaning: A confident mistake is more dangerous than an uncertain one. This is the immune system against lessons that make themselves stronger every time they're used — catch it, isolate it, trace where it spread, re-check it, fix it.
human_view.why_it_matters: Without this, the learning loop compounds errors instead of intelligence. One self-reinforcing false lesson can outrun every correction.

simple_view.meaning: A confident mistake is more dangerous than an uncertain one. This is the immune system against lessons that make themselves stronger every time they're used — catch it, isolate it, trace where it spread, re-check it, fix it.

naya_view.directive: Run the seven-predicate qualify_lesson before any lesson promotion. When a reinforcement pattern is detected (rising confidence without new independent evidence), execute the five-stage pipeline in order; never skip QUARANTINE while tracing. Preserve the wrong version with its correction — deletion erases the fossil record successors need.

ai_view.specification: qualify_lesson(L): seven predicates all true before promotion. On detection of self-reinforcement: state QUARANTINED; retrieval excludes the lesson; TRACE enumerates downstream dependents; REVALIDATE requires evidence independent of the lesson's own history; RECOVER demotes or corrects with provenance preserved.
ai_view.directive: Follow as written. This is law, not guidance.

machine_view.spec_only: Spec-only by design; live KNOW/LAW/ACT wiring parked for the Human Director's word. No production claim.
machine_view.test_evidence: Error-defense spec: 46 tests green; strengthen() vulnerability reproduced before the defense was specified.

intelligence.learning_lesson: The strengthen() reproduction is the fossil: it proved the failure mode is real, not theoretical.
decisions: Shawn's word ratifies the teaching. His word IS the verification; no second verification of the lesson itself is permitted (Verification Law).

connections.target: SN-0750 Compounding — falsifier logic and anti-self-verification are the same immune response at a different layer.

intelligence.uncertainty: The seven predicates' exact thresholds are implementer-defined; the law fixes the pipeline order and the preservation rule, not the numeric cutoffs.
intelligence.applicability: Every seat that promotes, strengthens, or retrieves lessons.
intelligence.falsifier: Falsified if a strengthened false lesson passes the gate undetected, or if quarantine fails to stop downstream use of a flagged lesson.
intelligence.measurement_contract: Count reinforcement events caught at each pipeline stage; measure time from DETECT to QUARANTINE. A caught error is a success, not a failure.
intelligence.successor_effect: A cold successor that inherits a poisoned lesson finds it quarantined with its fossil record, traces the spread, and does not re-promote it — the mistake dies once, not repeatedly.
